title: Thaddeus Greene
summary: A Hunted character identified by ISAC at the novel's climax as the masked Hunter who attacks Brenda Wells's cell.

claims.text: Hunted identifies the masked combatant who attacks Brenda Wells's cell as Thaddeus Greene in an ISAC result, while Greene's status is classified.
This one novel identification does not establish a universal origin, command structure or identity rule for Hunters elsewhere in The Division.

sections.heading: A source-specific Hunter identification — major spoilers

paragraphs.text: At Hunted's climax, ISAC identifies the masked attacker as Thaddeus Greene and marks his status classified. The archive records that as a source-specific identification rather than flattening the mystery of every Hunter into one answer.

verification.notes: Major-spoiler licensed-novel record. It records one named Hunter appearance and explicitly leaves broader Hunter origin and organization unresolved.
